_about: This repository's own values, laid over bowline's defaults.json. Each key below is one a repository usually decides for itself; the rest keep their defaults. Reasons are in bowline's defaults.json and docs/facts.md.
_crew: For a repository where several Claude Code sessions work at once, each in its own worktree: name the processes that must not run beside one another (heavy), the ports of your own servers (keepPorts), the numbered lists the sessions extend (numbers), the files every session adds to by rule (shared) and the files a build stamps with a commit (stamps); the keys and their reasons are in bowline's defaults.json, and /bowline:crew is the procedure.
_decisions: Name the files that record decisions (records), as paths or patterns from the repository's top: the design document, the roadmap, a folder of decision records. bowline decisions find lists them first when a session looks a subject up before it asks you a question. With none named, bowline takes the documents whose name says so; bowline decisions records prints which.
_autosplit: Set enabled to true to let bowline prepare the split of a CLAUDE.md that outgrew the limits in the background, on a branch for you to review and merge. A headless Claude Code session does it on your account, and one split may spend up to maxBudgetUsd, 20 dollars by default; the other keys and their reasons are in bowline's defaults.json.
